 Lara Trump dubbed 'ridiculous and desperate' as she poses in 'pretty girl' shirt
 Lara Trump, President Donald Trump's daughter-in-law faced a slew of backlash on social media after she wore a T-shirt that said 'Pretty girls vote red' at a rally on Friday
 Add to preferred sources Liz Foster 14:41 ET, 31 Oct 2026 View 3 Images Lara Trump faced backlash on social media after she wore a t-shirt that said 'Pretty girls vote red'
 Lara Trump faced backlash on social media after she wore a controversial T-shirt.
 ‌ 
 ‌ 
 “Friday night with grandpa,” wrote Lara, 43, on X on October 31 as she attached a photo of herself with her husband Eric and their two children at a rally in Florida . President Donald Trump , Lara’s father-in-law, spoke on Friday in Daytona Beach as he championed Republican candidates in the state ahead of the November midterm elections. Lara posed in a shirt that read, “Pretty girls vote red.”
 “Pretty girls vote red? Ridiculous and desperate,” wrote one user on X in response to Lara’s post. “So much cringe. One does not proclaim themselves pretty. Pretty is a compliment bestowed on you by others. You're all so bad at being human,” declared one comment.
 ‌ 
 READ MORE : Lara Trump's struggles to sell $2,499 tickets to her Mar-a-Lago meet and greet READ MORE : Fox News' Lara Trump slams The View hosts saying they 'hold absolutely no weight with anybody' “Oh I cannot WAIT for them to be young adults and learn who grandpa really was, they’ll go no contact with all of you if they’re smart,” added another, referencing Lara’s two children, Eric Luke, 9, and Carolina Dorothy, 7, shown in the photo.
 “What kind of grown woman/mother wears a shirt like that lol,” posted one user, denouncing Lara’s choice to wear the T-shirt.
 View 3 Images Lara Trump received backlash online for her shirt
 ‌ 
 Some comments praised Lara’s looks and her support of Trump, but most took aim at both the president and his daughter-in-law.
 “‘Pretty Girls Vote Red,’ but Obama is divisive and elitist?” asked one commenter. “Maybe it’s just her way of letting us know she voted for Democrats.”
 ‌ 
 Just days earlier, Vice President JD Vance threw a jab at former President Barack Obama.
 “Obama, without even trying to be, just can’t help himself from being super elitist,” said Vance in an interview with Fox News.
 ‌ 
 View 3 Images Lara hosts her own Fox News show (Image: LaraLeaTrump/X) 
 Lara, meanwhile, made headlines with a pricey upcoming luncheon with “special guest [conservative commentator and Republican politician] Tudor Dixon” for entrepreneurs.
 One tier of tickets cost a whopping $2,499, which allows the buyer “access to the exclusive Mar-a-Lago Club and an elegant leadership luncheon with Lara Trump and distinguished guests on Friday, November 13. Specific check-in and location details will be provided after purchase."
 The event is described as a "distinguished luncheon with Lara Trump and special guest Tudor Dixon at Mar-a-Lago, designed for those shaping the next chapter of American life, business, culture, and conservative leadership.”
 "Set in one of the nation’s most iconic venues, this experience will bring together accomplished female leaders, entrepreneurs, and civic voices for a high-touch afternoon centered on American legacy, family, faith, and the responsibility of influence in a defining cultural moment,” continues the description.
 The luncheon will be held in the “White & Gold ballroom “ and is “curated for meaningful conversation, strategic relationship building, and a shared vision for our nation's future.”
